definitions.oracle_physical_target: raw_physical_target after canonical encode then canonical decode

metric_definitions.reduction: For each channel, sum squared errors and squared reference values over all evaluated pairs/voxels, then take sqrt(sum_error_sq/sum_reference_sq).
metric_definitions.channel_average: unweighted arithmetic mean of the eight per-channel relative L2 values

excess_absolute.definition: E_model_raw - E_oracle_raw; a norm difference, not an error decomposition
